description: Explain a transaction in plain English (AI). Plain-English explanation of any transaction on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism: what happened, who sent what to whom (decoded token transfers with amounts and symbols), the method called, fee paid, and success/failure. Returns a summary plus the structured facts it is based on. Example output: {"chain":"base","hash":"0x…","summary":"Wallet 0xa729… sent 0.0009 USDC to 0x1074… (an x402 payment), settled by a facilitator. Succeeded; fee ~$0.0001.","facts":{"status":"success","method":"0xe3ee160e","transfers":[]}}. Price: $0.012 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: ai_tx_explain
